confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough estimates from travel blogs, hotel menus in other Indian cities, and a Leh restaurant guide. No Leh menu with current prices was found, and the excise policy coverage gave no beer price. Cocktail and wine are set from the beer-to-cocktail and beer-to-wine ratios seen in Indian hotel menus, not from Leh prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and July peak-season context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure I could find (20 March 2026), not the latest RBA observation for November 2026. The RBA daily table could not be retrieved, so this rate should be refreshed before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: South Asia basis, using Indian high-altitude tourist towns and Indian hotel bar and cafe menus as proxies. Leh's remote supply chain and July peak-season demand are reflected in the upper end of the accommodation estimates.
